title: [CQ-F03] Structured execution contract
description:
Objective: Extend existing task and submit_plan contract with intended behavior, criteria, invariants, compatibility, approved scope, reuse/source assumptions and check references.

Deliverable: Structured execution contract. This is task F03 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): F02, M01.
definitionOfDone: Material changes advance planRevision through the same durable task write.
Sanitization, bounds and producer/consumer schema tests prevent silent contract loss.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

comments.author: qa-cq-f02
comments.content: Nonblocking F02 QA documentation handoff: packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts Task.planRevision comment still describes changes to sanitized implementationPlan/steps without explaining the new canonical approval-only projection. F02 intentionally owns only taskStore.ts, held-out enablement and the authorized legacy expectation change; do not add an unauthorized fourth-file edit there. In F03/schema/docs sweep, document that ordered step identity, original/effective instructions and approved file scope/DoD are material, while execution status/timestamps/reported modifiedFiles/progress notes and amendment audit/inactive history are not. Submission still advances once; caller stamps remain daemon-owned. This comment is not an approval/readiness certification.
